quest.title: Mycological Investigation in The Chasm
quest.description: The Chasm has a complex ecological and geological system. One of the most curious things here is the glowing mushrooms. Help the Sumeru scholar Khedive to investigate the mushrooms that grow in The Chasm...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x40000

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, about these mushrooms...

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: No wonder they say you're an experienced adventurer — You came back with new findings so soon.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: Huh? Are you sure you found them here? How strange...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is it strange for mushrooms to grow underground?

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: That's not what I mean.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: It's just that they look similar to an indigenous mushroom in Sumeru.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: I can't be sure yet with what we've got here. If I have enough samples, I might be able to arrive at a conclusion.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: Speaking of which... Since you found it, you must know where to get more. Could you lend a hand?

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: Bring me enough mushrooms and I'll pay you handsomely.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, how many is enough?

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: Mmm... Lemme think. Please bring me eight for starters.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: Don't worry. So long as you bring them to me, I'll make sure to repay you in full!

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: Have you got them all?

talks.objective: Bring the shining mushrooms back to Khedive for appraisal

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here're the mushrooms you asked for.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: You have my thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: With your help, my research is — what do they call it in Liyue? — "as smooth as a cat soaring in the air."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Like a winged tiger?

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: Yes, like a winged tiger!

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: What happened to these fungi?

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: How strange. They look almost identical to an indigenous species in Sumeru save for the fluorescein. Why? Is it because they've evolved in the darkness?

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: But why does their look remain the same after the evolution?

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Hmm... Simply put, fungi evolve to adapt to their surrounding environment, but by the looks of it, this type of fungi is more suited to living in forest environments.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: That's why I'm so certain of their Sumeru origin.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Since they aren't an indigenous species of The Chasm, they didn't evolve to glow. Rather, the glowing is a result of some abnormal ecological phenomenon...

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: It's probably because of the fragment that fell from the sky. After absorbing its energy...

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Ahem... Huh? What did you say? Something about a "fragment"? Um, I mean, when the fragments of fungi fell from the sky, they must've...

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Uh... Thank you for collecting these fungi. It's been a busy day. Please go get some rest, you've earned it!

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: I'm gonna study them now, so if you wouldn't mind leaving me alone for a bit...
